notes.title: 1.4 - Dutch translation + Bug Fixes (Windows only)
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! Here's a new update to the game, adding a new language option: Dutch!

I'm very excited to share the game with my Dutch-speaking friends, because it makes the game feel much closer to the heart to have its text readable in your mother tongue. 

The translation system and Dutch translation were done by my friend Lidwien, so big thank you to her! She completely translated the game without having ever played it - just looking at the source code. Hopefully she will find time to play through the game with her own translation soon :)

Hopefully in the future, more languages can be added. In any case, it will be much easier with the system for it in place!

Besides this, I managed to squeeze in a few fixes as well. 

Changelog

 Added Dutch language option. (set language from title or pause menu)
 Fixed bunny and fish's follow and transformation sprites.
 Fixed a softlock where you'd get stuck in a ledge at the end.


Next up will be the MacOS version of the translation, and hopefully fixing the achievements on Mac.

Thanks for playing, and remember not to listen to your brain too much!

- Ruben

notes.title: Version 1.3: Bug & Soft Lock fixes
notes.notes:
Hi everyone! Just a quick update fixing a bunch of stuff!

Changelog

 Fixed a softlock when swimming under the green bottle in the swamp.
 Fixed a softlock up the ledge in the old tree.
 Added an interaction with Old Toad in which he will just tell you the melody notes when shown the completed sing slab (a lot of people were having much trouble replicating the melody by ear).
 Removed the coin near the green sing stone, because there were 21 coins in total instead of 20.
 Made the green sing stone more obvious to collect.
 Small graphical improvements.
 Added Steam screenshots (press F12 to take one)!


Known issues

 The steam integration doesn't seem to work on Mac, and I can't get it to work just yet. This means that F12 screenshots, the Steam overlay and Steam Achievements will not work on Mac... I'll try to fix this soon!


The update is live on Windows and Mac. The game will update automatically. It might happen that you'll get 2 green sing stones if you have a save at a very specific point, but that won't break the game! It will give you 6/5 sing stones though...

Thanks to everyone who reported a bug, and for playing the game! I'm very happy with the warm response to it... Thanks for letting me know that you liked it!

- Ruben
